title: Models Engineering Index
excerpt: Mei calculates language models' practical performance on engineering tasks.
content_html:
Mei—or, the Models Engineering Index—calculates language models' practical performance on engineering tasks. Mei calculates language models' engineering performance.

Each model's score is a composite index across 16 coding benchmarks, adjusted for benchmark difficulty and missing results so models average 50. Cost and token use are adjusted the same way and shown relative to the typical model (1×).
